document: CAQM revised GRAP schedule, Order dated 13 Dec 2024 (Stage III and Stage IV C&D clauses)
found: yes (order text; copy hosted by CREDAI NCR, not caqm.nic.in)
passage: Order opens: "Comprehensively revised schedule of the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP)" dated "13th December, 2024"; para 5: "the Commission hereby further issues a comprehensively revised schedule of the GRAP duly incorporating all the aforesaid changes, for implementation with immediate effect"; schedule page headed "(Revision: 13.12.2024)". STAGE III (Delhi AQI 401-450), action 1 Construction & Demolition activities: "(i) Enforce strict restrictions on the following categories of dust generating/ air pollution causing C&D activities in the entire NCR: Earthwork for excavation and filling including boring & drilling works. Piling works. All demolition works. Laying of sewer line, water line, drainage and electric cabling etc. by open trench system. Brick / masonry works. Operation of RMC batching plant. Major welding and gas-cutting operations. Minor welding activities for MEP works ... to be, however, permitted. Painting, polishing and varnishing works etc. Cement, Plaster / other coatings, except for minor indoor repairs/maintenance. Cutting / grinding and fixing of tiles, stones and other flooring materials, except for minor indoor repairs/maintenance. Road construction activities and major repairs. Transfer, loading / unloading of dust generating materials like cement, fly-ash, bricks, sand, murram, pebbles, crushed stone etc. anywhere within / outside the project sites. Movement of vehicles carrying construction materials on unpaved roads. Any transportation of demolition waste. (ii) All construction related activities, other than those listed under 4(i) above, which are relatively less polluting / less dust generating shall be permitted to be continued in the NCR, subject to strict compliance of the C&D Waste Management Rules... (iii) All C&D related activities, including those under 4(i) above, shall be continued to be permitted only for the following categories of projects ...: (a) Projects for Railway services and stations (b) Projects for Metro Rail Services and stations (c) Airports and Inter State Bus Terminals (d) National security/ defence related activities/ projects of national importance; (e) Hospitals/ health care facilities (f) Linear public projects such as highways, roads, flyovers, over bridges, power transmission/ distribution, pipelines, tele-communication services etc. (g) Sanitation projects like sewage treatment plants and water supply projects etc. (h) Ancillary activities, specific to and supplementing the above project categories." Stage III also: "2. Close down operations of stone crushers in the entire NCR." "3. Close down all mining and associated activities in the entire NCR." STAGE IV (Delhi AQI > 450), action 3: "Ban C&D activities, as in the GRAP Stage- III, also for linear public projects such as highways, roads, flyovers, overbridges, power transmission, pipelines, tele- communication etc."
notes: Text read from the PDF text layer (OCR-quality; header number garbled, body clean). The same Stage III clause list is confirmed independently in the PIB release of 16 Dec 2024 (https://pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2084963, read as original_text), which says "Complete details of the revised schedule of GRAP (December, 2024) are available on the Commission's website". The official CAQM copy was NOT retrieved: caqm.nic.in answers (200) but is an Angular app whose GRAP Schedules page (https://caqm.nic.in/landingpage/pages/grap/grap-schedule) loads the file table by script; search lists it as "Revised Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP) for NCR December, 2024, 13/12/2024, 548 KB". The CAQM-hosted file name could not be found; the guessed GRAP Order link from search returned HTML. Treat the CREDAI file as a mirror: compare with the caqm.nic.in PDF when downloading by hand. Later amendments exist (Nov 2025 order revises Stage IV action 1 for BS-IV trucks); C&D clauses above are as of Dec 2024. The Stage III C&D cross-reference "4(i)" in clause (ii) is in the original text.

document: Rajya Sabha reply on Gujarat MSME production loss after heavy rains/floods (Rs 36.81 crore, 958 units)
found: yes (but facts differ from the brief)
passage: RAJYA SABHA UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 107, TO BE ANSWERED ON 25.11.2024, "PRODUCTION LOSS DUE TO HEAVY RAINS", asked by SHRI PARIMAL NATHWANI, answered by MINISTER OF STATE FOR MSME (SUSHRI SHOBHA KARANDLAJE), Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises. "(a) & (b): As per the information received from the State Governments, 958 industrial units from the State of Gujarat and 490 industrial units from the State of Andhra Pradesh were reported affected due to heavy rains, this monsoon. The State of Jharkhand has reported no production loss due to heavy rains." "(c): No proposal has been received by Ministry of MSME during Financial Year 2024-25 (till date) on relief or compensation from Industries, MSMEs, or any Industry Associations due to production losses caused by heavy rains. Representations received from the State of Andhra Pradesh and Gujarat have asked for relief/ compensation of Rs. 18,434 lakhs and Rs. 36,811 lakhs respectively for production loss due to heavy rains/flood damages."
notes: DISCREPANCIES with the brief: (1) date is 25 Nov 2024, not about 4 Dec (4 Dec 2024 is the date of a trade-press article, constructionworld.in, that reported it, and of Home Ministry starred Q98 on Gujarat rain losses, not read). (2) The figure is Rs 36,811 lakhs = Rs 368.11 crore, NOT Rs 36.81 crore; the press article mis-converted it ("Rs 3.36 Bn" in its headline, "Rs 3.68 billion" in the body). (3) The answer does not mention Vadodara or the Aug 2024 floods; 958 units and the claim are for the whole State of Gujarat. Any Vadodara attribution comes only from the press article. Found through the Rajya Sabha question search API behind rsdoc.nic.in (session 266); PDF downloaded directly from sansad.in.
